name: elbow flexor stretch
description: A wall-assisted stretch for the muscles on the front of the upper arm that bend the elbow.
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall and place the palm of one straight arm lightly against it.
Keep the shoulder relaxed and slowly turn your torso away until you feel a gentle stretch along the front of the upper arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing, then switch sides.
